ask-anything.line: - Codex is not set up. Where this file or a skill says Codex, look things up with WebSearch and WebFetch (several searches in one turn). The court's GPT seat stays empty: leave it out without comment.
- Antigravity (Gemini) is not set up. The court's Gemini seat stays empty: leave it out without comment.
- `/court` is always held as the full court, with its three Claude seats; don't offer the quick court, which needs an outside seat.
- No generated pictures here (the picture skill needs Codex): say so in one line and offer a description or a diagram.
